test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the following sentence.

Ideas are present in the __consciousness__, which when released and given scope to grow and take shape, can lead to successful events.
solution:
The correct answer is- **"awareness"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, **"awareness" **is the most appropriate synonym of **"consciousness"**.

 
 
• **Consciousness:** the quality or state of being aware especially of something within oneself.

 
 
• **Example:** A conscious mind is very prone to learn things easily.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, ***option 3)*** is the correct alternative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us understand the meaning of other options too.

 
• **Ignorance: **the quality or fact of ignorance; a lack of information, education, or other knowledge, etc.

 
 
• **Example: **Being **ignorant **about your skin care may lead to dryness.
 
 
 
• **Thoughtlessness: **Absent-minded, Lack of thought
 
 
• **Example: **Her daughter was hurt due to her **thoughtlessness** in the kitchen.
 
 
 
• **Negligence: **inattentive, lack of care
 
 
• **Example: **The accident of the bus happened due to** negligence **of the driver.
